background: Deutsche Bank is Germany's largest bank, a universal bank with a large investment bank, a corporate bank, German retail banking under the Deutsche and Postbank brands, and the DWS asset manager.
synthesis: Ratings are A+ from Fitch after the upgrade on 12 May 2026, A from S&P and A1 from Moody's, with Fitch and S&P both on a positive outlook, so the direction is up. The ratios are on the weak side of EU and Nordic peers: CET1 of 13.9% and leverage of 4.5% are both in the bottom quarter against medians of 16.4% and 5.5%, LCR of 140% is in the bottom quarter and NSFR of 118% is below the 124% median. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods. The flagged news is mostly legal settlements on 7 Sep 2026 and 8 Sep 2026, none large for a bank of this size.
